about: The parts of one whole as a ring, largest first from 12 o'clock, with a figure such as the total in the hole. Everything the pie chart does applies.

incidents.about: maxSlices={4} gathers the three smallest causes into one slice named by otherLabel, and the hole counts every incident.
incidents.caption: Deploys caused 14 of the 35 incidents this quarter, 40%.
incidents.label: Incidents per cause this quarter
incidents.title: Long tail

largest.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the largest slice when the chart first renders. The pointer or the arrow keys move it from slice to slice.
largest.caption: Video's 118 GB are 60% of the storage in use.
largest.title: Tooltip

narrow.about: The storage in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The ring scales down with the room, and the total is written in the hole.
narrow.title: Narrow room

replay.about: animate grows the ring from 12 o'clock when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the ring at once.
replay.title: Animation

share.about: The hole shows the largest share in place of a total. The chart does not compute the figure, so the caller states what it is.
share.caption: Starter has 47% of the 1,300 customers.
share.label: Customers per plan
share.title: Largest share in the hole

title: Donut chart

unused.about: A chart without slices renders the empty state in the plot's place, and no legend or figure in the middle.
unused.caption: Storage per kind of file.
unused.title: Empty

usage.about: Storage per kind of file with the total in the hole, which the example sums and writes in the page's language.
usage.caption: Video takes 60% of the 195.5 GB in use.
usage.label: Storage per kind of file
usage.title: Total in the hole
